name: Principles of Characterization of Functional and Technical Textiles
description: Characterization of low-stress mechanical characteristics: bending, shear, tensile, frictional, and surface roughness characteristics; KESF systems and analysis; FAST system and analysis. Characterization of transmission characteristics: thermal transmission; liquid transmission (wetting and wicking); moisture vapour transmission. Characterization of various technical textile materials: extreme heat, fire, and cold protective clothing; geotextiles; filter fabrics; fibre reinforced composite materials, electromagnetic shielding textiles; compression bandages; ballistic protective textiles; UV protective textiles; hygiene and medical textiles; cut protective textiles, automotive textiles; etc. Analysis of test results, practical numerical in different sections.
